record.rationale: INCLUDE: The work is motivated by decoding in-situ-sequencing microscopy barcodes for spatial transcriptomics, builds an ISS-specific PLePI-ISS framework and biological benchmarking resource, and evaluates cell calling against NGS abundance and existing ISS decoders. Body sections 1, 4.5 and 5.2–5.3 plus Tables 2–3 confirm primary biological experiments; COCO is an additional generic proof of concept, not grounds to exclude the biological research.

record.title: Relation-enhanced DETR for Component Detection in Graphic Design Reverse Engineering
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract concerns detecting text, icons and buttons in graphic-design screenshots, modeling layout class relations, and augmenting layout generation. The research objective and stated evaluation are design reverse engineering, not medicine or biological science.

record.title: Sequential Attention Source Identification Based on Feature Representation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: Although the abstract uses infection terminology, the introduction explicitly defines multiple rumor source detection in social networks. Section 4.1/Table 1 identify Karate, Jazz, Facebook, Twitch-ES, Wiki-Vote and Page-Large; Section 4.3 simulates independent-cascade rumor propagation, and Table 2 evaluates source localization on those networks. This is misinformation diffusion, not disease transmission.

record.title: Differentially Private Partial Set Cover with Applications to Facility Location
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The core theoretical method is general differentially private partial set cover, but its developed application and entire main-paper empirical evaluation address mobile vaccine-clinic placement. Section 3 gives a vaccine-distribution formulation using population travel patterns; Section 4/Table 1/Figure 2 test Charlottesville and Albemarle mobility populations and vaccination travel-distance/privacy tradeoffs. This is actual primary public-health service-delivery experimentation, not an incidental vaccine example.

record.title: Voice Guard: Protecting Voice Privacy with Strong and Imperceptible Adversarial Perturbation in the Time Domain
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract studies imperceptible adversarial audio to prevent zero-shot voice-conversion impersonation. A psychoacoustic perception model serves speech-privacy protection; neither a biomedical outcome nor a physiology-research task is the work’s primary focus.

record.title: GLPocket: A Multi-Scale Representation Learning Approach for Protein Binding Site Prediction
record.rationale: INCLUDE: Protein binding-site prediction is the explicit problem throughout the abstract; GLPocket predicts protein binding-site masks using multiscale local/global structure and is evaluated against binding-site prediction baselines. This is structural bioinformatics relevant to drug discovery.

record.title: Multi-view Contrastive Learning Hypergraph Neural Network for Drug-Microbe-Disease Association Prediction
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The stated research task is prediction of higher-order drug–microbe–disease associations, with a DMD hypergraph and direct computational evaluation of that biomedical association task.

record.title: Robust Steganography without Embedding Based on Secure Container Synthesis and Iterative Message Recovery
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops secure image-container synthesis and robust hidden-message recovery for steganography. Its objectives are secrecy, tamper robustness and synthesis fidelity, not biological or medical inference.

record.title: Choosing Well Your Opponents: How to Guide the Synthesis of Programmatic Strategies
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops reference-strategy selection for program synthesis in two-player zero-sum games and evaluates three games including MicroRTS. The actual research target is game-playing strategy search.

record.title: Toward Convex Manifolds: A Geometric Perspective for Deep Graph Clustering of Single-cell RNA-seq Data
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The explicit target is identifying cell heterogeneity by clustering single-cell RNA-seq gene-expression data. The method changes latent geometry for this biological analysis and evaluates gene-expression datasets.

record.title: Unveiling Concepts Learned by a World-Class Chess-Playing Agent
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract probes neural-network concepts in a world-class chess engine and compares its game-state evaluation with handcrafted evaluation. This is interpretability of chess-playing models, not measurement or modeling of a biological brain.

record.title: Revisiting the Evaluation of Deep Learning-Based Compiler Testing
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract revisits evaluation of deep-learning program generators for compiler testing, introduces mutational program generation, and measures compiler hangs/crashes. Its research focus is software testing.

record.title: Transferable Curricula through Difficulty Conditioned Generators
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops transferable curricula for reinforcement-learning agents in parameterized environments. Human learning and item-response theory motivate curriculum design, but the stated experiments are RL training rather than health, neural physiology or clinical intervention.

record.title: JEPOO: Highly Accurate Joint Estimation of Pitch, Onset and Offset for Music Information Retrieval
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract studies joint pitch/onset/offset estimation for melody extraction across musical instruments and single-/multi-pitch recordings. This is music information retrieval, not a biomedical application of audio.

record.title: HireVAE: An Online and Adaptive Factor Model Based on Hierarchical and Regime-Switch VAE
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops an adaptive latent factor model to predict stock returns from historical market information and evaluates stock-market benchmarks. Its objective is quantitative investment.

record.title: A Diffusion Model with Contrastive Learning for ICU False Arrhythmia Alarm Reduction
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The explicit clinical objective is reducing false arrhythmia alarms in intensive care. The conditional diffusion model predicts patient waveforms and distinguishes true versus false alarms, with evaluation on MIMIC II arrhythmia data in retrospective and real-time settings.

record.title: VecoCare: Visit Sequences-Clinical Notes Joint Learning for Diagnosis Prediction in Healthcare Data
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The method jointly represents patient visit sequences and clinical notes for diagnosis prediction. Both the task, EHR inputs and reported evaluation concern healthcare diagnosis, not merely generic language modeling.

record.title: Spotlight News Driven Quantitative Trading Based on Trajectory Optimization
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract presents news-driven quantitative trading and decision-trajectory optimization to maximize financial profits. Its data and evaluation concern trading rather than biomedical outcomes.

record.title: GPMO: Gradient Perturbation-Based Contrastive Learning for Molecule Optimization
record.rationale: INCLUDE: Molecule optimization for de novo drug design is the explicit focus. GPMO learns from matched molecular pairs for drug discovery and evaluates molecule-optimization performance; contrastive-learning generality does not remove the stated drug-design research purpose.

record.title: InitLight: Initial Model Generation for Traffic Signal Control Using Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops adversarial inverse-RL pretraining for traffic-signal-control agents and evaluates convergence and adaptation across traffic intersections. The target is transport control.

record.title: Don't Ignore Alienation and Marginalization: Correlating Fraud Detection
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract models correlated multi-relation fraudulent behavior and synergistic camouflage in online fraud detection. Alienation/marginalization denote fraud graph patterns rather than health conditions.

record.title: Realistic Cell Type Annotation and Discovery for Single-cell RNA-seq Data
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The research problem is cell-type annotation and discovery in single-cell RNA-seq, including newly observed cell types and batch effects. The optimal-transport framework is expressly built and evaluated for biological cell annotation.

record.title: Towards Generalizable Reinforcement Learning for Trade Execution
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract models stock trade execution as offline RL with dynamic market context and evaluates a limit-order-book simulator. The target is reducing trading cost, not healthcare.

record.title: SemiGNN-PPI: Self-Ensembling Multi-Graph Neural Network for Efficient and Generalizable Protein–Protein Interaction Prediction
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The complete abstract centers protein–protein interaction prediction, using multiple protein/label graphs and self-ensembling on PPI data. Evaluation addresses sparse annotations and unseen proteins in this biological interaction problem.

record.title: Deep Hashing-based Dynamic Stock Correlation Estimation via Normalizing Flow
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract estimates dynamic stock-correlation matrices for portfolio allocation and evaluates financial decisions. Its normalizing-flow method is not applied to a biomedical research task in the stated study.

record.title: MolHF: A Hierarchical Normalizing Flow for Molecular Graph Generation
record.rationale: INCLUDE: Body review confirms a molecular-design study with substantive drug-design experimentation, not only a generic graph benchmark: Section 5.2 explicitly optimizes quantitative drug-likeness (QED), Table 3 reports novel molecules by QED, and Tables 4–5 evaluate constrained molecular property optimization on ZINC. Polymer generation is a separate scaling experiment. Inclusion is computational drug-design methodology; the paper does not establish therapeutic efficacy or a disease-specific biological effect.

record.title: Keep Skills in Mind: Understanding and Implementing Skills in Commonsense Question Answering
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract concerns closed-book commonsense question answering and learned skill representations, evaluated on general CQA datasets. It does not study clinical question answering or biological learning processes.

record.title: An Effective and Efficient Time-aware Entity Alignment Framework via Two-aspect Three-view Label Propagation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract proposes efficient entity alignment between temporal knowledge graphs through label propagation and temporal constraints. The stated objective is generic knowledge fusion and scalability, not biomedical knowledge discovery.

record.title: One Model for All Domains: Collaborative Domain-Prefix Tuning for Cross-Domain NER
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract studies cross-domain named-entity recognition on Cross-NER using collaborative domain-prefix tuning. It presents a general-domain transfer problem rather than a primary biomedical text-mining question.

record.title: Less Learn Shortcut: Analyzing and Mitigating Learning of Spurious Feature-Label Correlation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract analyzes shortcut word/label correlations in text classifiers and evaluates question matching, natural-language inference and sentiment analysis. The stated tasks are generic language robustness, not medicine.

record.title: KEST: Kernel Distance Based Efficient Self-Training for Improving Controllable Text Generation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops self-training for controllable text generation, addressing mode collapse, diversity and computational efficiency. It does not formulate a biomedical generation or analysis task.

record.title: Regularisation for Efficient Softmax Parameter Generation in Low-Resource Text Classifiers
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: Focused body review of the introduction, method and Sections 4.1–4.4/Tables 1–2 confirms generic few-shot NLP meta-learning. Training uses GLUE/SNLI; evaluation uses Amazon reviews, CoNLL-2003 entities, airline sentiment, disaster tweets, emotions and political classifications. Emotion labels are ordinary tweet NLP, not a clinical mental-health or biological experiment.

record.title: SmartBERT: A Promotion of Dynamic Early Exiting Mechanism for Accelerating BERT Inference
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract optimizes BERT inference by dynamic early exit and layer skipping, evaluated on eight GLUE classification datasets. The objective is language-model speed/accuracy, not biomedical inference.

record.title: Cross-Modal Global Interaction and Local Alignment for Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract studies audio-visual speech recognition with cross-modal alignment on LRS3/LRS2. It addresses multimodal transcription robustness, not a clinical or biological speech condition.

record.title: Explainable Text Classification via Attentive and Targeted Mixing Data Augmentation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: Focused body review confirms generic sentiment-classification augmentation. Section 4.1 and Table 1 specify SST-1/2, YELP-2/5 and IMDB; Table 2 reports accuracy on these review/sentiment benchmarks. The work does not use medical text as its primary experiment.

record.title: ScriptWorld: Text Based Environment for Learning Procedural Knowledge
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract introduces text-based games representing daily chores to teach commonsense procedural knowledge to RL agents. Human activities are simulated game content, not biomedical behavioral or health research.

record.title: Towards Incremental NER Data Augmentation via Syntactic-aware Insertion Transformer
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops syntactically controlled data augmentation for few-shot NER, evaluated on OntoNotes and Wikiann. Its stated experiments concern general named entities, not biomedical information extraction.

record.title: Towards Lossless Head Pruning through Automatic Peer Distillation for Language Models
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract recycles information from pruned Transformer attention heads through peer distillation, evaluated on all nine GLUE tasks. This is model compression without a primary medical/biological target.

record.title: Annealing Genetic-based Preposition Substitution for Text Rubbish Example Generation
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract creates nonsensical text perturbations to test NLP model undersensitivity using a genetic optimization algorithm. The word genetic refers to the search algorithm, not biological genetics.

record.title: iRe2f: Rethinking Effective Refinement in Language Structure Prediction via Efficient Iterative Retrospecting and Reasoning
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract improves iterative graph refinement for language-structure prediction with fewer parameters. Its research problem is efficient linguistic parsing, not biological structures or healthcare.

record.title: Local and Global: Temporal Question Answering via Information Fusion
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops temporal knowledge-graph question answering using local/global entity information and time-aware embeddings. The stated target is generic temporal QA rather than a biomedical question or dataset focus.

record.title: PPAT: Progressive Graph Pairwise Attention Network for Event Causality Identification
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract studies causal relations among textual event mentions, evaluated on EventStoryLine, MAVEN-ERE and Causal-TimeBank. These are language-event reasoning tasks, not causal discovery from clinical or biological data.

record.title: Meta-Tsallis-Entropy Minimization: A New Self-Training Approach for Domain Adaptation on Text Classification
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops instance-adaptive Tsallis-entropy self-training for cross-domain text classification and evaluates BERT domain adaptation. The described research target is generic NLP transfer rather than medicine or bioscience.

record.title: ODEE: A One-Stage Object Detection Framework for Overlapping and Nested Event Extraction
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The central question is overlapping and nested event extraction. Table 1 shows FewFC supplies no nested events; Genia11/13 are the biomedical nested-event task. In addition to explicit BioBERT experiments and main Table 3, Section 5.2/Figure 4(c–d) separately evaluate Genia13 sentences containing nested events. Removing the biomedical experiments removes empirical validation of the nested half of the central claim, making this a primary biomedical text-mining strand, not incidental coverage. Caveat: the method is domain-general and component/runtime ablations are FewFC-only; no claim that this paper is exclusively biomedical.

record.title: Learning to Speak from Text: Zero-Shot Multilingual Text-to-Speech with Unsupervised Text Pretraining
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract develops zero-shot multilingual text-to-speech for languages with text-only resources. Evaluation concerns synthesized-speech intelligibility and language coverage, not clinical speech restoration or physiology.

record.title: Case-Based Reasoning with Language Models for Classification of Logical Fallacies
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract applies case-based reasoning and language models to classify logical fallacies and misinformation arguments. The task is reasoning robustness and argument analysis, not biomedical research.

record.title: Fine-tuned vs. Prompt-tuned Supervised Representations: Which Better Account for Brain Language Representations?
record.rationale: INCLUDE: The explicit scientific question is how model language representations account for human brain activity. Neural decoding predicts linguistic stimuli from stimulus-evoked brain activity and compares tuning/task effects; this is primary cognitive-neuroscience/physiology research even without a disease application.

record.title: SQuAD-SRC: A Dataset for Multi-Accent Spoken Reading Comprehension
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract introduces multi-accent spoken reading-comprehension data from 24 speakers and evaluates spoken QA. Human speech collection serves a language benchmark, not biomedical or physiological analysis.

record.title: PasCore: A Chinese Overlapping Relation Extraction Model Based on Global Pointer Annotation Strategy
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: Body introduction/method and Section 4.1/Tables 1–3 confirm general Chinese overlapping-relation extraction with DuRED and ICRED derived from language-technology competitions, plus NYT24 English news. Its examples and schema concern general named entities and relations; it does not use a primary medical relation-extraction task.

record.title: Privacy-Preserving End-to-End Spoken Language Understanding
record.rationale: EXCLUDE: The complete abstract protects speech/identity information from attacks in end-to-end spoken-language understanding for IoT. Identity and speech recognition are privacy adversaries, not clinical or biological study outcomes.

Beyond Pure Text: Summarizing Financial Reports Based on Both Textual and Tabular Data
record.rationale: Financial report summarization from text and tables, with a constructed financial dataset. The research target is financial document NLP, not biomedical reporting.

record.title: Learning Summary-Worthy Visual Representation for Abstractive Summarization in Video
record.rationale: Introduction frames open-domain web/YouTube video summarization. §4.1 and Tables 1–4 evaluate How2, How2-300 and MM-AVS using summarization metrics. No biomedical strand is present; this is general multimodal video NLP.

record.title: TITAN : Task-oriented Dialogues with Mixed-Initiative Interactions
record.rationale: Mixed-initiative task-oriented dialogue dataset derived from MultiWOZ 2.1 and response/dialogue-act prediction. No clinical or biomedical research task is identified.

record.title: Efficient Sign Language Translation with a Curriculum-based Non-autoregressive Decoder
record.rationale: Efficient sign-language-to-text translation on PHOENIX2014T and CSL-Daily. This is language/accessibility technology, not research on hearing disorders, clinical care, or biological mechanisms.

record.title: Fast-StrucTexT: An Efficient Hourglass Transformer with Modality-guided Dynamic Token Merge for Document Understanding
record.rationale: Visual document understanding efficiency assessed on FUNSD, SROIE, and CORD. These are document parsing/receipt/form tasks, not biomedical research.

record.title: Exploring Effective Inter-Encoder Semantic Interaction for Document-Level Relation Extraction
record.rationale: Body resolves unspecified benchmarks: §3.1 names Wikipedia/Wikidata DocRED and its Re-DocRED/Revisit-DocRED revisions, plus DWIE. Tables 1–2 verify those are the four evaluated corpora. No CDR/GDA or biomedical relation extraction is evaluated.

record.title: NerCo: A Contrastive Learning Based Two-Stage Chinese NER Method
record.rationale: §4.1 explicitly identifies news-domain OntoNotes/MSRA, Sina Weibo, and senior-executive resumes; Table 3 evaluates these NER tasks. The method addresses entity-token representation, not biomedical entity recognition.

record.title: Genetic Prompt Search via Exploiting Language Model Probabilities
record.rationale: Genetic terminology denotes prompt optimization, not genes. §4.1 and Tables 1–2 show sentiment, news/DBPedia topic classification, paraphrase and textual inference on SST-2, Yelp, AG News, DBPedia, MRPC, SNLI and RTE. No biomedical experiment.

record.title: Learning Few-shot Sample-set Operations for Noisy Multi-label Aspect Category Detection
record.rationale: Few-shot noisy multi-label aspect category detection for sentiment analysis, with sample-set operations. No biomedical objective or experiment is described.

record.title: COOL, a Context Outlooker, and Its Application to Question Answering and Other Natural Language Processing Tasks
record.rationale: Introduction/method target general local-context NLP. §4 and later task descriptions evaluate SQuAD QA/QG, GLUE inference, SWAG commonsense, CoNLL NER/POS, and SST/IMDB sentiment; Table 7 and Malay SQuAD Table 8 confirm non-biomedical task domains.

record.title: DiSProD: Differentiable Symbolic Propagation of Distributions for Planning
record.rationale: Stochastic continuous-space planning, with control of ground vehicles and surface vessels around obstacles. The actual experiments and objective are robotics/navigation, not medicine.

record.title: Minimizing Reachability Times on Temporal Graphs via Shifting Labels
record.rationale: Temporal-graph reachability acceleration by shifting edges, with complexity and graph-class algorithms. No biomedical research objective or evaluation is stated.

record.title: On the Compilability of Bounded Numeric Planning
record.rationale: Complexity/compilability theory for bounded numeric and classical planning fragments. Not biomedical modeling or empirical life science.

record.title: On the Study of Curriculum Learning for Inferring Dispatching Policies on the Job Shop Scheduling
record.rationale: Curriculum reinforcement learning for job-shop dispatching, evaluated on Taillard and Demirkol scheduling instances. Manufacturing scheduling focus, not biomedical.

record.title: Simulation-Assisted Optimization for Large-Scale Evacuation Planning with Congestion-Dependent Delays
record.rationale: Routing and scheduling disaster evacuation in Harris County, including congestion simulation. Civil evacuation logistics rather than medical triage, clinical treatment, or biological research.

record.title: K∗ Search over Orbit Space for Top-k Planning
record.rationale: Symmetry-pruned K* search for top-k planning, with soundness/completeness and planner-performance comparison. No biomedical research target or evidence.

record.title: Helpful Information Sharing for Partially Informed Planning Agents
record.rationale: Helpful information sharing between partially informed planning agents, classical-planning compilation and sensor placement. No clinical or biological task identified.

record.title: Mean Payoff Optimization for Systems of Periodic Service and Maintenance
record.rationale: Periodic service/maintenance scheduling on graph nodes to maximize long-run payoff. Abstract concerns algorithmic maintenance scheduling, not physiological or clinical service processes.

record.title: Action Space Reduction for Planning Domains
record.rationale: Automated action-label reduction using lifted mutex groups for classical planning and model-free RL. Evaluations target planning efficiency/sample complexity, not biomedical inference.

record.title: Recursive Small-Step Multi-Agent A* for Dec-POMDPs
record.rationale: Exact Dec-POMDP planning algorithm improving scalability over multi-agent A*. Standard planning benchmark performance, not a biomedical target.

record.title: Generalization through Diversity: Improving Unsupervised Environment Design
record.rationale: Unsupervised environment design for robust RL generalization across benchmark environments. Abstract frames maze/game-style decision making, not biomedical modeling.

record.title: Can I Really Do That? Verification of Meta-Operators via Stackelberg Planning
record.rationale: Verification of meta-operators via Stackelberg planning and compact high-level action representation. Classical planning problem, without a medical or biological aim.

record.title: Topological Planning with Post-unique and Unary Actions
record.rationale: Linear-time planning restrictions for non-player characters in video games, scaling to millions of NPCs. Explicitly game AI rather than biomedical research.

record.title: Model Predictive Control with Reach-avoid Analysis
record.rationale: The actual numerical examples are a drone-position/velocity system and 2D/3D Van der Pol oscillators. Tables 2–4 report controller iteration costs and computation time. Oscillatory dynamics are generic control examples, not fitted physiological models or medical experiments.

record.title: Formal Explanations of Neural Network Policies for Planning
record.rationale: Formal explanation of sequences chosen by neural-network policies, implemented on ASNet classical planning domains. Explanations concern planning behavior, not clinical decisions.

record.title: Optimal Decision Tree Policies for Markov Decision Processes
record.rationale: §5.1 enumerates 13 environments: 3D navigation, blackjack, Frozenlake, inventory, sysadmin, tic-tac-toe, tiger/antelope gridworld, traffic, and XOR. Table 2 measures returns/tree optimization runtime; neither the animal-named toy environment nor interpretability motivation is biomedical research.

record.title: Online Task Assignment with Controllable Processing Time
record.rationale: Online task/machine assignment with controllable processing time, rejection budgets, and competitive-ratio proofs. Algorithmic scheduling, not medicine or biology.

record.title: A Rigorous Risk-aware Linear Approach to Extended Markov Ratio Decision Processes with Embedded Learning
record.rationale: Risk-aware extended Markov ratio decision-process theory and algorithms, validated on Grid World. Safe AI is not medical safety here; actual experiment is a generic planning benchmark.

record.title: Learning to Act for Perceiving in Partially Unknown Environments
record.rationale: Active perception with symbolic planning and online neural confidence, evaluated on synthetic data and a real robot. Object/environment sensing rather than medical or physiological measurement.

record.title: Learning to Self-Reconfigure for Freeform Modular Robots via Altruism Proximal Policy Optimization
record.rationale: Self-reconfiguration of modular robots via distributed multi-agent RL and communication-limited termination. Physical robotics control, not biological cells or clinical robotics.

record.title: Multi-Robot Coordination and Layout Design for Automated Warehousing
record.rationale: Warehouse layout optimization and multi-robot pathfinding to reduce congestion and raise throughput. Explicitly automated warehousing, not healthcare.

record.title: Stochastic Population Update Can Provably Be Helpful in Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms
record.rationale: Theory and benchmarks for stochastic population update in multi-objective evolutionary algorithms, including OneJumpZeroJump. Evolution/population refers to optimization, not biological research.

record.title: The First Proven Performance Guarantees for the Non-Dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II) on a Combinatorial Optimization Problem
record.rationale: Runtime guarantees for NSGA-II and global SEMO on the bi-objective minimum spanning tree problem. Genetic algorithm analysis is not genetics.

record.title: Complex Contagion Influence Maximization: A Reinforcement Learning Approach
record.rationale: The introduction mentions HIV prevention, nutrition and preventative-health behavior as possible uses. Actual §6 experiments optimize simulated generic social influence under chosen cascade/threshold parameters, with Table 1 reporting normalized influence across mixed social graphs. Homeless-youth-shelter graph provenance is not a health intervention endpoint; there is no primary disease, clinical, or biological experiment.

record.title: On Optimal Strategies for Wordle and General Guessing Games
record.rationale: Optimal strategy theory for guessing games, illustrated with Wordle. Not biomedical.

record.title: Runtime Analyses of Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithms in the Presence of Noise
record.rationale: Runtime analysis of evolutionary multi-objective optimization under objective noise on OneMinMax. Population/diversity are algorithmic constructs, not life-science targets.

record.title: Diverse Approximations for Monotone Submodular Maximization Problems with a Matroid Constraint
record.rationale: Approximation/diversity guarantees for submodular optimization under matroid constraints, tested on maximum vertex coverage. Not biomedical research.

record.title: Efficient Object Search in Game Maps
record.rationale: Grid Tree spatial/text indexing for moving game objects, benchmarked on game maps. Explicit video-game retrieval focus.

record.title: Sorting and Hypergraph Orientation under Uncertainty with  Predictions
record.rationale: Learning-augmented sorting and hypergraph orientation under uncertain inputs, with query/competitive guarantees. Pure algorithmic uncertainty research, no biological or clinical target.

record.title: Parameterized Local Search for Max c-Cut
record.rationale: Parameterized local search and hardness for Max c-Cut plus graph-cut benchmark improvements. No biomedical research objective is described.

record.title: Exploring Structural Similarity in Fitness Landscapes via Graph Data Mining: A Case Study on Number Partitioning Problems
record.rationale: Structural similarity of fitness landscapes using local-optima networks for number partitioning and simulated annealing. Fitness is combinatorial optimization, not biological fitness.

record.title: An Exact Algorithm for the Minimum Dominating Set Problem
record.rationale: Biological/ENZYMES/gene graphs genuinely occur in Table 3, but §5 defines all trials as minimum-dominating-set solver comparisons. Outcomes are runtime, graph optimum and solved-instance counts, with no biological interpretation/validation or biomedical target. Biological graph provenance is incidental benchmarking, not a primary biomedical study.

record.title: A Refined Upper Bound and Inprocessing for the Maximum K-plex Problem
record.rationale: §6 includes biological networks within Network Repository, but the research and Table 1 evaluate generic maximum k-plex search-space pruning and number of graph instances solved. No protein/cell/medical property is modeled or interpreted; biological network provenance alone is not qualifying primary biomedical experimentation.

record.title: Levin Tree Search with Context Models
record.rationale: Levin tree search with compression-derived context models, evaluated on Sokoban, The Witness, sliding tiles, and Rubik's cube. Game/puzzle search, not medicine.

record.title: Front-to-End Bidirectional Heuristic Search with Consistent Heuristics: Enumerating and Evaluating Algorithms and Bounds
record.rationale: Theory and evaluation of bidirectional heuristic search with consistent heuristics, focusing on node expansion and efficiency bounds. No biomedical target is stated.

record.title: PathLAD+: An Improved Exact Algorithm for Subgraph Isomorphism Problem
record.rationale: Introduction lists biochemical/cheminformatics applications, but §4.1 and Table 1 show a subgraph-isomorphism solver evaluation on segmented-image, mesh, synthetic, LV and LargerLV benchmark groups. Outcomes are solved-instance counts/runtime; no biomedical prediction/discovery task is conducted.

record.title: A Fast Maximum k-Plex Algorithm Parameterized by the Degeneracy Gap
record.rationale: Network Repository includes biological graphs, but §5 and Table 1 study generic k-plex degeneracy gaps, branching factors, runtime and solved instances. The paper supplies no primary biological/clinical objective or domain-result interpretation, so biological graphs are incidental inputs to solver benchmarking.

record.title: A Mathematical Runtime Analysis of the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm III (NSGA-III)
record.rationale: Mathematical runtime analysis of NSGA-III on the 3-objective OneMinMax benchmark. Evolutionary algorithm nomenclature does not imply biological study.

record.title: Probabilistic Rule Induction from Event Sequences with Logical Summary Markov Models
record.rationale: Substantive mixed case. Introduction motivates diabetes care and uses a diabetic event-sequence example; §5.1 actually predicts blood-glucose/dosage/other patient events, with Diabetes values in main Table 1 and influencing-set sizes in Table 2. However, shared generic prediction/structure-learning protocols cover several domains, no clinical endpoint, disease-specific finding or clinical interpretation is developed, and §5.3 is societal-event text generation. The body establishes real biomedical experiments but not clearly a primary biomedical research strand rather than a routine benchmark. Preserve HOLD, not an include based on dataset presence/count or an exclude merely because the method is generic.

record.title: On the Complexity of Counterfactual Reasoning
record.rationale: Computational complexity of counterfactual reasoning using SCM treewidth, twin networks, and random SCM experiments. Theoretical causal inference, not causal analysis of a biomedical question.

record.title: FedNoRo: Towards Noise-Robust Federated Learning by Addressing Class Imbalance and Label Noise Heterogeneity
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 而非 Figure 1：完整呈现按类别识别含噪客户端、差异化训练、知识蒸馏和距离感知聚合的核心两阶段贡献；Figure 1 仅对比噪声图模型。
record.scope_reason: Medical label quality and between-hospital disease imbalance directly motivate the method and its clinical per-class-noise assumption. Section 5 and Tables 1–2 evaluate diagnosis of five intracranial-hemorrhage subtypes in brain CT and eight skin diseases on ICH/ISIC2019. This is biomedical-primary empirical work despite a reusable federated-learning method; the study remains retrospective with simulated client partitions and injected label noise.

record.title: Graph Sampling-based Meta-Learning for Molecular Property Prediction
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 而非 Figure 1：它把分子–性质关系图、候选子图池、可学习采样调度器以及分类/对比联合优化连成完整算法流程，最直接对应本文贡献。
record.scope_reason: Introduction frames early drug lead optimization and sparse assay labels; the molecule–property graph explicitly models correlated molecular side effects/properties. Section 4/Table 1 and analyses predict Tox21, SIDER, MUV, ToxCast and PCBA toxicity/side-effect/bioassay labels. This is biomedical drug-discovery research, not merely generic graph benchmarking; it is in-silico retrospective validation without new wet-lab or clinical efficacy evidence.

record.title: A Noisy-Label-Learning Formulation for Immune Repertoire Classification and Disease-Associated Immune Receptor Sequence Identification
record.reason: 审阅其他结果图后选择 Figure 1：其三个面板同时展示噪声标签协同修正、序列与受体库双层推断，以及 TCR-BERT/FT-Transformer 结构，直接解释核心方法；并非因图号默认选择。
record.scope_reason: The full abstract directly centers immune repertoire classification and disease-associated immune receptor sequence identification, evaluated on CMV and cancer data at both repertoire and sequence levels. The noisy-label method serves a primary computational immunology task, not an incidental biomedical benchmark.

record.title: Pseudo-Labeling Enhanced by Privileged Information and Its Application to In Situ Sequencing Images
record.reason: 选择 Table 3 而非通用教师–学生框架图，直接展示 ISS 条形码/细胞识别的恢复、NGS 一致性、错误发现与推理时间之间的实际权衡。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The work is motivated by decoding in-situ-sequencing microscopy barcodes for spatial transcriptomics, builds an ISS-specific PLePI-ISS framework and biological benchmarking resource, and evaluates cell calling against NGS abundance and existing ISS decoders. Body sections 1, 4.5 and 5.2–5.3 plus Tables 2–3 confirm primary biological experiments; COCO is an additional generic proof of concept, not grounds to exclude the biological research.

record.title: Differentially Private Partial Set Cover with Applications to Facility Location
record.reason: 选择 Figure 2 的两地区疫苗服务距离–预算曲线，直接说明算法在公共卫生应用中的隐私/可达性权衡；不以普通选址示意图代替实际评估。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The core theoretical method is general differentially private partial set cover, but its developed application and entire main-paper empirical evaluation address mobile vaccine-clinic placement. Section 3 gives a vaccine-distribution formulation using population travel patterns; Section 4/Table 1/Figure 2 test Charlottesville and Albemarle mobility populations and vaccination travel-distance/privacy tradeoffs. This is actual primary public-health service-delivery experimentation, not an incidental vaccine example.

record.title: GLPocket: A Multi-Scale Representation Learning Approach for Protein Binding Site Prediction
record.reason: Figure 3 完整呈现全局编码、目标裁剪和局部 Transformer 三者的联系，最直接解释小口袋预测的核心贡献；没有选择 Figure 1 的蛋白质示意图。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: Protein binding-site prediction is the explicit problem throughout the abstract; GLPocket predicts protein binding-site masks using multiscale local/global structure and is evaluated against binding-site prediction baselines. This is structural bioinformatics relevant to drug discovery.

record.title: Multi-view Contrastive Learning Hypergraph Neural Network for Drug-Microbe-Disease Association Prediction
record.reason: Figure 2 展示四种负样本构造场景下的 hit@n 与 ndcg@n，直接支撑稀疏三元关联预测的效果，并保留各场景差异而不是只展示总体流程。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The stated research task is prediction of higher-order drug–microbe–disease associations, with a DMD hypergraph and direct computational evaluation of that biomedical association task.

record.title: Toward Convex Manifolds: A Geometric Perspective for Deep Graph Clustering of Single-cell RNA-seq Data
record.reason: Table 2 同时展示过聚类与对抗机制的单独/联合效果及运行时间，可直接核对核心设计的增益与代价，比只展示整体网络框架更适合说明贡献。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The explicit target is identifying cell heterogeneity by clustering single-cell RNA-seq gene-expression data. The method changes latent geometry for this biological analysis and evaluates gene-expression datasets.

record.title: A Diffusion Model with Contrastive Learning for ICU False Arrhythmia Alarm Reduction
record.reason: Figure 3 对照真实与虚假室性心动过速报警的动脉血压波形，直观解释“生成的真实事件模式与观察信号距离”这一关键判别思路；该图仅为示例，不替代总体结果表。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The explicit clinical objective is reducing false arrhythmia alarms in intensive care. The conditional diffusion model predicts patient waveforms and distinguishes true versus false alarms, with evaluation on MIMIC II arrhythmia data in retrospective and real-time settings.

record.title: VecoCare: Visit Sequences-Clinical Notes Joint Learning for Diagnosis Prediction in Healthcare Data
record.reason: Figure 2 将异构 EHR 对齐、掩码预训练与双通道病例检索串联起来，完整展示三部分方法如何作用于诊断预测；不选择首页的临床笔记示意图。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The method jointly represents patient visit sequences and clinical notes for diagnosis prediction. Both the task, EHR inputs and reported evaluation concern healthcare diagnosis, not merely generic language modeling.

record.title: GPMO: Gradient Perturbation-Based Contrastive Learning for Molecule Optimization
record.reason: 该图完整呈现条件化分子翻译与正、负梯度扰动对比学习三个核心部分；它解释方法贡献，比单一优化分子实例更能代表论文。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: Molecule optimization for de novo drug design is the explicit focus. GPMO learns from matched molecular pairs for drug discovery and evaluates molecule-optimization performance; contrastive-learning generality does not remove the stated drug-design research purpose.

record.title: Realistic Cell Type Annotation and Discovery for Single-cell RNA-seq Data
record.reason: 该示意图同时显示已知类型部分对齐、未知类型原型学习和细胞对一致性三条路径，直接解释统一标注与发现的贡献，而非只选择第一张图。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The research problem is cell-type annotation and discovery in single-cell RNA-seq, including newly observed cell types and batch effects. The optimal-transport framework is expressly built and evaluated for biological cell annotation.

record.title: SemiGNN-PPI: Self-Ensembling Multi-Graph Neural Network for Efficient and Generalizable Protein–Protein Interaction Prediction
record.reason: 选取跨训练集/测试集结果图而非默认架构图，直接体现论文在分布变化下的泛化和利用未标注数据进行适应的核心贡献；图中 DG、IDA、TDA 的不同数据访问条件保留在原图注中。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: The complete abstract centers protein–protein interaction prediction, using multiple protein/label graphs and self-ensembling on PPI data. Evaluation addresses sparse annotations and unseen proteins in this biological interaction problem.

record.title: MolHF: A Hierarchical Normalizing Flow for Molecular Graph Generation
record.reason: 该图同时展现分子原子/键分解、粗化图条件流、CC-Glow 和可逆生成路径，直接解释分层从粗到细生成的技术贡献；相比单个分子示例更具代表性。
record.scope_reason: INCLUDE: Body review confirms a molecular-design study with substantive drug-design experimentation, not only a generic graph benchmark: Section 5.2 explicitly optimizes quantitative drug-likeness (QED), Table 3 reports novel molecules by QED, and Tables 4–5 evaluate constrained molecular property optimization on ZINC. Polymer generation is a separate scaling experiment. Inclusion is computational drug-design methodology; the paper does not establish therapeutic efficacy or a disease-specific biological effect.
